title: shootdown of LZ 37
summary: The Zeppelin LZ 37 was shot down on 7 June 1915 as the first lighter-than-air dirigible destroyed by a heavier-than-air aircraft, resulting in ten fatalities.

title: crash of LZ 40
summary: On 3 September 1915, the Zeppelin LZ 40 crashed near Cuxhaven, Germany, resulting in 19 deaths.
